r.정치 구도: A federal parliamentary system led by the prime minister, with the British monarch as formal head of state. The Liberals and the Conservatives take turns in power, and first-past-the-post voting means vote shares and seat counts can differ widely. The 10 provinces have strong powers and run health, education and resource policy. French-speaking Quebec is so distinct that it held independence referendums twice, in 1980 and 1995, and reconciliation with Indigenous peoples is an important political task.

t.why: A member of the G7 and NATO, and of both the Commonwealth and the international organization of French-speaking countries. It shares the world's longest border with the United States and sells most of its exports there, so a single US tariff can shake its entire economy. It is a resource giant rich in oil, uranium, potash and critical minerals. As the Arctic melts, the status of the Northwest Passage, Arctic resources and security have become new issues. In 2023 it clashed diplomatically with India over the killing of a Canadian citizen.
t.rel: It shares the world's longest border with the United States and sells about three-quarters of its exports there. US tariffs and talk of Canada as the '51st state' badly shook relations in 2025.
t.korea: The two established relations in 1963, and Canada sent a large force to the Korean War. Their free trade agreement took effect in 2015. A key supplier of minerals and energy to Korea, with defense cooperation such as submarines under discussion. Many Koreans live there after studying or emigrating.
t.know: Canada has the longest coastline of any country.
etext: Its crude oil reserves are among the world's largest, mostly in Alberta's oil sands. It also sells lots of potash, uranium, timber, nickel and wheat.

Its big banks are so solid that they weathered the 2008 financial crisis well. Large public pension funds invest in infrastructure around the world. It also has renowned universities and institutes in AI research.
Most exports go to the United States, so it is shaken hard by US tariffs. Low productivity and expensive housing are problems.
